column3: J'yhuh Tia seems pleased with your progress.

J'yhuh Tia smiles to see you return hale, hearty, and perhaps tougher for your time away. That said, he is also keen to check on your Cu Sith, and asks you to summon your first familiar for his assessment.

Your Cu Sith appears well, and despite J'yhuh Tia's reservations, eager to challenge the Crucible once more. His inspection is cut short by an unexpected visitor, this time not a gaunt maiden but an excited adventurer─the very one with whom you spoke in the Carline Canopy so long ago. He introduces himself as Sylmond and brightly recounts his journey to find your Cu Sith. With amazement, he kneels before it and asks permission to feed it. Considering how hard you have been training, J'yhuh Tia calls for a moment of respite.

Having marveled over your Cu Sith, Sylmond reluctantly departs for other business, leaving you, J'yhuh Tia, and the strangely taciturn Loosefrox alone. When questioned on her silence, Loosefrox suddenly announces her intention to challenge the Crucible of the Unbroken. She is determined to prove her prowess as your senior, brooking no argument as she dashes off to challenge the first board. Your teacher worries not for your safety─both you and Loosefrox are skilled beastmasters in your own right─but there is no denying that her bestiary is larger. Thus are you instructed to commit at least twenty entries to your own before challenging the second board.
Upon searching near and far, you return with twenty trusty familiars. All is in readiness to challenge the second board, so you and J'yhuh Tia venture off to visit Lauda in Bentbranch Meadows.

You arrive to find a triumphant Loosefrox waiting for you. She has swept through the first board and is prepared to meet you upon the second. According to Lauda, the Crucible encourages competition with its ability to pit rivals against each other during the final battle. Everything upon the board is smoke and mirrors, however, so you will combat the shade of Loosefrox during your trial, while she will independently challenge a shade of you. J'yhuh Tia promises to rescue you should anything go awry, but otherwise encourages you both to try your best─may the cleverest beastmaster win.

※The next beastmaster quest will be available from Lauda upon clearing the Second Board of the Unbroken.
Summon your Cu Sith and speak with J'yhuh Tia.
Befriend twenty unique beasts and speak with J'yhuh Tia.
Speak with Lauda.
Pshhh... Shkohhh... Of the Unbroken, eh?
Coming along nicely. Won't be long before the student becomes the master, heh.
By the by, how's your Cu Sith? I'm keen to have a look at it.
Remember, your first pact will always be your strongest. Summon your Cu Sith so we can say hello.
Healthy and in good spirits...though I sense apprehension. Perhaps in regards to the Crucible?
Ghraaah!
Or not, haha! A stalwart soul for a stalwart beastmaster. You two are quite the team.
(-???-)Ah! That's it─the very creature!
And the very lady who heard my tale. We spoke at the Carline Canopy, remember? The name's Sylmond. It's a delight to properly make your acquaintance.
Friend of yours? ...Strangers all look the same to me.

I've been desperate to find that beast since last we spoke! I poked around Sorrel Haven to no avail─well, to some avail, because I was apprehended by a Wood Wailer for suspicious behavior. But upon further inquiry, I heard that beastmasters had been practicing at the Bannock!
My, what a marvelous creature you are. How glad I am to see you well!
Ghhhrl...♪
May I feed it? I brought some raw meat with me, in anticipation of such an opportunity.
It isn't spoiled, I assure you! I can even consume some if that might put your mind at ease.
What will you say?
Worry not. I trust you.
Thanks, but, er...keep your meat.
You honor me, madam. Thank you... Thank you!
I understand... Strange meat should not be trusted.
Then use some of mine. The Cu Sith looks peckish, and I can vouch for my cuts.
You've been hard at work anyway, Player. Let's have a break.
What a joy this has been... Alas, my duties call. May we meet again, brave beastmasters!
...Bit of an odd chap. But he brought with him a valuable reminder.

Lauda mentioned you can feed and tend to your charges within the Crucible. The detail to which the Lhu crafted their simulacrum continues to amaze... But what resources it offers, you must use. Overlook no chance to secure safety and gain advantage.
As for you, chief pupil of mine─what troubles you? Your tongueflaps are scarce.
Wiseteach... I'm going to challenge the Crucible.
As your senior, I won't stillstand while you take all the winfame. I'll prove to you that I'm just as strong─no, *stronger*!
I'll see you on the second board, Player. For now, I'm off to sweepclear the first!
...That's quite the change of heart. Any insight?
Loosefrox is no fool. And since you safely cleared the first board, she should be more than capable. ...Stirred by competition though she is.
But unless you're keen to become “peoplepulp” beneath her heel, you'll need to catch up. Return with at least twenty entries in your bestiary. Nothing less will do against Loosefrox.
Pshhh... Shkohhh... I'll see you on the second board!
If ever the two of you are in danger, I will fly to your side. But a good teacher knows when to let his pupils fight their own battles. Twenty familiars, Player. I'll be waiting.
Well done, Player. With this many allies, there's little you'll find difficult to overcome.
Time for the second board. Let us be off.
Pshhh... Shkohhh... First board? *Easy*.
Should anything go awry, I will come and get you. The *both* of you.
Your comrade Loosefrox gave an amazing performance upon the first board. Am I given to understand that you both will be challenging the second?
How does that work? When more than one person enters.
The Crucible encourages growth through contention. Each challenger will navigate an individual board, at the end of which awaits their rival.
For Loosefrox, the shade of Player will appear. For Player, the shade of Loosefrox.
The two of you are evenly matched in my eyes. If the shades replicate you truly, your wits alone will determine the victor.
Pshhh... Then call me a winner, Wiseteach. I'll show you that Player is no match for me and Chewchum Popoto!
The Second Board of the Unbroken has been unlocked. To challenge it, speak with Lauda in Bentbranch Meadows.
Furthermore, new wares are now available from the Kornago merchant.
